title: Continuous-wave laser absorption spectroscopy of the thorium-229 nucleus
title_zh: 连续波激光吸收光谱测量铀-229核
abstract: Abstract The low-energy nuclear transition in thorium-229 (Th-229) has been excited in thorium-doped crystals with laser light 1–3 , opening the path towards a highly stable and robust solid-state optical nuclear clock 4 . The required laser radiation at 148-nm wavelength has so far been produced using pulsed laser systems, in which only a small fraction of the incident photons has been resonant with the narrow nuclear transition. Here we show that the nucleus can be excited with a continuous-wave (CW), narrow-bandwidth, solid-state laser source 5 at sub-nanowatt power and that the nuclear resonance signal can be detected in absorption rather than fluorescence. This eliminates the slow nuclear fluorescence decay from the detection process, allowing for clock operation with fast signal acquisition. We characterize two different thorium centres in a calcium fluoride (CaF 2 ) crystal and measure the isomeric shift between them. One of the centres shows a very small static electric crystal field gradient <0.1 V Å −2 compared with gradients in the range of 100 V Å −2 observed previously 3,6 . This indicates a centre with high symmetry of the ions surrounding the thorium nucleus, promising nuclear resonance lines that are nearly independent of the lattice spacing.
abstract_zh: 摘要：铀-229（Th-229）低能核跃迁已在掺铀晶体中通过激光光照激发1–3，开启了高稳定性、稳健的固态光学核钟4的研究路径。所需的148 nm波长激光辐射迄今仅通过脉冲激光系统产生，其中只有极少量入射光子与窄核跃迁共振。本文展示了可用连续波（CW）、窄带宽固态激光源5在亚纳瓦功率下激发核，并且可通过吸收而非荧光检测核共振信号。这消除了检测过程中的慢核荧光衰减，使时钟能够快速获取信号。我们对钙氟（CaF₂）晶体中的两种不同铀中心进行了表征，并测量了它们之间的等位移。一个中心显示出极小的静电晶格场梯度<0.1 V Å⁻²，远低于先前观察到的100 V Å⁻²梯度3,6。这表明该中心具有高对称性的离子环境，预示着几乎与晶格间距无关的核共振线。
